name: Indonesia
change_summary: The corrected base under PP 6/2025: JHT 2%/3.7%; JP 1%/2% with the 10,547,400 ceiling; JKK I–V 0.10–1.60% and JKM 0.30%; JKP 0.14% employer; Kesehatan 1%/4% with the Perpres 59/2024 art.32(2) minimum-wage floor; PPh 21 TER; PP 35/2021 working time and the statutory leave heads.

work_rules.authority: Peraturan Pemerintah No. 35 Tahun 2021 Pasal 27(1) — an employer who employs a worker beyond the Pasal 21(2) working hours must pay overtime wages; the regulation sets no wage threshold, and its only exception (Pasal 27(2)) is by job group, which this workspace cannot yet express. Pasal 26(1) caps overtime at 4 hours in a day and 18 hours in a week, and Pasal 26(2) puts overtime worked on a weekly rest day or an official public holiday outside that cap. Undang-Undang No. 13 Tahun 2003 Pasal 79(2)(a) as amended by Undang-Undang No. 6 Tahun 2023 gives a break of at least 30 minutes after 4 continuous hours, not counted as working time, and Pasal 79(2)(b) one rest day for every 6 working days in a week. Applied 2026-09-18: PP 35/2021 art.32(1)–(4): the overtime hour is 1/173 of the monthly wage, basic plus the fixed allowances (`terms.monthly_wage`); art.21: the normal day is seven hours on a six-day week, eight on a five-day one (`normal_hours`); art.26(2): rest-day and holiday overtime are outside the four-hour and eighteen-hour ceilings, which the monthly counter already leaves out. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): PP 35/2021 art.28: overtime is on the employer’s order with the worker’s consent — an ordinary-day overrun the employer did not order (`work_days.requested_by` EMPLOYEE) earns no overtime; the order is presumed unless HR marks the day. Art.27(2): the exception for a job group of planners, thinkers and executors paid above the norm is the MANAGERIAL classification the employer designates (`overtime_when`).

wages.authority: PP 36/2021 art.7(2): basic wage is at least 75% of basic wage plus fixed allowances. Perpres 82/2018 art.32(2)-(3), as amended: BPJS Kesehatan uses the workplace UMK; UMP applies only where no UMK is set. Kepgub Jawa Barat 561.7/Kep.798-Kesra/2024, effective 1 January 2025. All 27 West Java cities and regencies have a UMK; select the workplace city or regency, not the province. Sectoral minimum wages require a separate applicable order.

name: Indonesia — 2026-01-01

name: Indonesia — 2026-03-01
